handoff: Review approved: AC1–AC7 met with S1 tests, suite+typecheck green; minor F1 (lone unit-key arg to story answer becomes the answer), nit F2 (duplicated BS9 predicate).

findings.title: One positional that looks like a unit key is taken as the answer text
findings.detail:
With the unit optional, `norn story answer gh-3` (text forgotten) treats 'gh-3' as the answer: in a unit worktree it is delivered to that worktree's unit as the literal answer 'gh-3'. B24's `[<unit>] …` makes the form ambiguous by design, but a lone positional matching STORY_KEY_PATTERN (or a slice key) is almost certainly a missing answer.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: When the only positional is a valid unit key, refuse with a usage error ('the answer is missing', do_instead 'norn story answer gh-3 "<text>"').

findings.title: BS9 waiting condition written twice
findings.detail:
`updatable.applies` re-spells the `waiting` predicate (done | stuck | parked at gate) inline on the view instead of sharing it; the two can drift.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Reuse one predicate over the shared status/park fields.
